Sharper than filed: pageHrefs is built from the LIVE-filtered set (:705, :788), so a link to a merely HIDDEN page becomes a link to Home too. 'Left broken, not redirected' is a PROPOSAL about the exporter, not today's behaviour. The last line also answers UX-B-31: there is no trash and undo is one editor-wide stack (HistoryManager), so the dialog stops over-promising instead of pretending a recently-deleted exists.
